title: Gold program context
description: What the author knew besides the source text when building a gold program: the environment, the deadline and the resource limits. These fill the slots of the T1/T3 prompt turns when the same source is given to a model.

environmentType.description: Value used for program.environmentType (kitchen, laboratory, event, fitness, ...).

deadline.description: When everything must be ready: a wall-clock time (HH:MM), an ISO-8601 timestamp, or a short phrase. Omit when the source states none.

constraints.description: Resource limits as a prompt would state them, one per entry (e.g. "one oven", "four burners", "two cooks").

domain.description: Gold-set category used for per-domain reporting.

servesOrScale.description: How many people, samples or participants the source is written for.

notes.description: Authoring notes: judgement calls, why a step was marked inferred, etc.
